$comment: Machine-readable packaging facts for the docs (written by the packaging agent, 2026-11-12). Source of truth: package.json, js/*.mjs, js/*.d.mts, scripts/build.mjs, scripts/pack-test.mjs. Quote snippets verbatim; they are exercised by `npm run test:pack`.
name: bm-render
nameNote: Unpublished name (npm view bm-render -> E404 on 2026-11-12). The name appears only in package.json `name` (scripts/build.mjs copies it into js/build-manifest.json; the JS sources use it only in error messages and comments).
moduleFormat: ESM only ("type": "module"). No CommonJS build. From CommonJS use `await import("bm-render")`; on Node.js >= 20.19 / >= 22.12 `require("bm-render")` also works through require(esm) because no entry uses top-level await.
enginesNote: Tested on Node.js 26.13 only. The JS needs ES2022 classes with private methods, TextEncoder.encodeInto, WebAssembly SIMD + bulk memory (V8 >= 9.1), btoa, and fetch only for URL inputs. Symbol.dispose is used when present (else Symbol.for("nodejs.dispose")).

standard.features: 13: css, tw, html, svg, woff, variableFonts, cff, effects, modernColor, tables, floats, webpGifDecode, textWrapBalance (0x1fff)

full.features: all 18 (adds colorFonts, complexText, animation, extraCodecs, renderSvg; 0x3ffff)

woffAddon.what: WOFF/WOFF2 -> sfnt decoder for builds without the woff feature (bm-render/woff)

..what: Default entry. On Node.js / Bun / Deno ("node" condition): the FULL profile, initialised synchronously on import (env BM_WASM=<path> or BM_PROFILE=core|standard|full override the binary). Everywhere else: the environment-neutral API; call `await init(wasm)` with bytes, a URL, a Response or a WebAssembly.Module first (init() without an argument throws).

./core.what: core profile, its own wasm instance. Node: initialised on import. Elsewhere: `await init()` loads bm_render.core.wasm via new URL("./bm_render.core.wasm", import.meta.url) (bundler asset), or pass the wasm explicitly. Extra exports: `profile` ("core"), `wasmUrl()`.

./full.what: full profile, same shape as ./core. Separate instance from "." (importing both on Node loads the full wasm twice).

./woff.what: WOFF add-on: `await loadWoff(input?)` then registerFont accepts WOFF/WOFF2 on any entry without built-in support; `decodeWoff(bytes)`. Without an argument: Node reads bm_woff.wasm from disk, bundlers emit it via new URL(...).

conditionOrder: types, workerd, worker, edge-light, browser, node, default. Bun and Deno match "node" (they get the auto-initialising entries; untested here: neither runtime is installed on the build machine).

publicApi.initSemantics: Idempotent per entry: after the first successful init every call resolves to the same instance and ignores its argument; concurrent calls share one instantiation; a failed init can be retried. One wasm instance per entry module ("." + Node full share one; ./core, ./standard, ./full each have their own), so several profiles can be used in one process.
publicApi.renderSize: width / height are output pixels; devicePixelRatio scales CSS lengths, not the image size. Without width/height the root's laid-out size is used.
publicApi.typescript: Typings tested with TypeScript 5.9.3 (moduleResolution bundler and node16; lib with and without DOM; with @types/node) and 5.0. Byte outputs are typed `OutputBytes` = ReturnType<Uint8Array["slice"]> (Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> on TS >= 5.7, accepted by new Response()). Typings are ESM-only .d.mts files.

publishedFiles.note: whatever README.md is at pack time; README.vi.md is included too if present

tarball.note: sizes change with the wasm builds; re-run `npm pack --dry-run`

snippets.browserNoBundler:
<script type="module">
  import init, { Renderer } from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bm-render@0.1.0/js/index.mjs";
  await init(fetch("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bm-render@0.1.0/js/bm_render.core.wasm"));
</script>
snippets.browserNoBundlerProfile:
import { init, Renderer } from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bm-render@0.1.0/js/core.mjs";
await init(); // fetches bm_render.core.wasm next to core.mjs
snippets.featureCheck:
import { features } from "bm-render/standard";
if (!features.renderSvg) { /* renderSvg needs bm-render/full */ }

bundlerNotes.vite: Vite 8.3.8 tested (build + dev server, headless Edge 157): `init()` from bm-render/<profile> emits the wasm as an asset; `bm-render/full.wasm?url` works; no optimizeDeps config needed.
bundlerNotes.esbuild: esbuild 0.28 bundles cleanly for browser and workerd conditions but does not copy new URL() assets: pass the wasm to init() yourself (bytes, URL or module).
bundlerNotes.webpack: untested (webpack 5 understands new URL(..., import.meta.url) and the dynamic node:fs import is marked webpackIgnore).
bundlerNotes.cloudflareWorkers: simulated with `node --conditions=workerd` + init(WebAssembly.Module); not run under wrangler/workerd.
bundlerNotes.denoBun: untested (not installed); they resolve the "node" condition and use node:fs + import.meta.url, which both implement.
bundlerNotes.cdn: CDN snippets (jsDelivr) are untested until the package is published; the same files work when served from any static server (tested via Vite dist + Edge).

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs (needs Zig 0.17; writes js/*.wasm + js/build-manifest.json)
scripts.build:manifest: record the current js/*.wasm in js/build-manifest.json without rebuilding
scripts.verify: check js/*.wasm against the manifest + package.json placeholders
